registration_echo.harness: xfv_ungraded OOS protocol, hit side, low-minors gate cohort, forward chain (2019..2024); 2024 appended a-priori (newest labeled decision year in the regenerated matrix; the only fold reaching 2023+ feed coverage)
registration_echo.bar: low-minors pooled Spearman delta lo95 > 0; one attempt; marginal = FAIL
registration_echo.ship: efv_ungraded.py feature-list wiring default-OFF + provisional regen note; flip reserved to wave D

structural_note: Forward-chained coverage is structurally zero on the TRAIN side of every fold: the swing-decision features exist 2023+ (feed cache), but every labeled row whose milb_season reaches 2023 sits at decision year 2024 (test-only position). With zero covered train rows the ridge cannot place weight on the new columns (constant imputed column -> exact zero weight), so the gate delta is forced to ~0 regardless of feature quality. This is a coverage verdict, not evidence against swing-decision signal.
revival: Re-register after a matrix regeneration labels decision-year-2025 rows (2025 debuts / cutoff-2024 busts with observed seasons): the dy-2024 rows (milb_season 2023, covered) then become TRAIN rows for the dy-2025 fold and the same frozen protocol becomes expressible. Expected earliest: the 2027 cycle. The extraction + frozen feature build in this tool are reusable as-is; per-feature descriptive reads on the covered dy-2024 cohort are recorded above for that ledger.
